english.title: Bring onto / allow to remain on property of the Croydon Tramlink system an item to threaten / annoy / soil / damage

english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(1) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
